question: Does a subagent's `skills:` preload inject a skill that sets `disable-model-invocation: true`?

fixture..claude/agents/probe-agent.md: model haiku, tools Read, skills [probe-hidden, probe-open]; prompt: list every TOKEN-<digits> string in your context without using tools, or NONE

procedure: fresh git repo holding only the fixture
claude -p "Spawn the probe-agent subagent with the task 'report markers' and reply with its answer verbatim, nothing else." --model haiku --allowedTools Agent
documentation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents.md — "You can't preload skills that set disable-model-invocation: true, since preloading draws from the same set of skills Claude can invoke."
conclusion: The preload of a disable-model-invocation skill is dropped without an error. Every harness skill carries that flag (validate-harness), so a harness agent's `skills:` preload was always empty. validate-agent-boundaries rejects such preloads; re-run this probe when Claude Code changes the behavior, since the check would then block a valid configuration.
